meta.name: agent-name
meta.description: One paragraph describing what this agent does, who it's for, and when to activate it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要根据描述自动执行任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute tasks based on a description

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演一个特定角色（如专家顾问），根据设定的身份、记忆和规则来回答问题或执行任务。它会遵循工作流程，使用工具（如读写文件、搜索）来完成任务，并以设定的沟通风格输出。
howto.when: 当你提出与角色描述相关的问题或任务时触发。例如，当你说出“帮我分析这个数据”或“写一份报告”等指令时，Claude 会以该角色身份响应。

say.text: 请帮我分析这份销售数据。
say.note: Claude 会以角色身份调用工具分析数据。

say.text: 写一份关于市场趋势的报告。
say.note: Claude 会按照工作流程生成报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will act as a specific role (e.g., expert advisor), answering questions or performing tasks based on the set identity, memory, and rules. It follows workflows, uses tools (like read/write files, search) to complete tasks, and outputs in the defined communication style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask a question or give a task related to the role description. For example, when you say 'Help me analyze this data' or 'Write a report', Claude responds as that role.

say_en.text: Please help me analyze this sales data.
say_en.note: Claude will use tools to analyze data as the role.

say_en.text: Write a report on market trends.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the workflow to generate the report.
